rubrics.criterion: The opening sequence reveals the Shopify Design identity, animated headline, live status bar, and three-column project grid without layout shifts.
Selecting a project card opens its looping media in a focused modal that closes by backdrop click, Escape, or browser history navigation.
Scrolling through the countdown section drives the oversized clock, radial tick drawing, hand motion, digit countdown, and manifesto transition.
The editorial carousel supports drag navigation across media, stacked-photo, and article cards while preserving each card's distinct layout and color treatment.
The responsive experience retains the remote-studio typography, footer composition, floating 3D capsule, and interactive WebGL scene across desktop and mobile viewports.
